finalPrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Primary request: colorize the existing volume-18 Fu Xiaoli (福小莉) illustration crop. The user specifies that BOTH existing round money/coin hair ornaments are GOLD.
Input image 1 is the only EDIT TARGET. Preserve this exact crop, drawing, line work, proportions, face, lively open-mouth smile, large bright eyes, hair silhouette, head tilt, raised overlapping arms, and all garment folds. Do not expand or recompose the picture.
Input image 2 is PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY: the earlier AI-colorized volume-12 portrait of the same girl. Borrow only the restrained warm medium/deep brown skin and neutral black hair palette; do not copy its pose, prison clothing, chains, body framing, or expression.

Color image 1 as a polished anime/light-novel illustration with original soft tonal shading. Keep her long hair BLACK with subtle cool charcoal highlights. Keep her complexion naturally warm brown, consistent with reference 2, preserving the original facial features. Use neutral deep brown irises as a restrained artistic choice. Her Chinese-style mandarin-collar garment remains ivory-white with soft warm gray shadows; retain the two visible frog fasteners, wide sleeves, and the paired decorative bands at the sleeve edge, using understated warm-gold detail where the original ornamental linework already exists.
The two existing coin-like ornaments are the focus: one broad elliptical disc at upper right and one nearly edge-on disc at upper left, partially clipped by the frame. Render BOTH as warm metallic GOLD with gentle highlights and shaded gold relief. Preserve their exact sizes, positions, perspective, border contours, and original engraved geometric/character line patterns. Do not invent or rewrite lettering, add currency symbols, coin holes, red tassels, or extra jewelry.
Keep the original pale backdrop and simple shaded texture. Preserve the existing partial white/silver-clad figure at the right edge with pale neutral tones; do not turn that fragment into Fu Xiaoli's skin or black hair, and do not invent a new face or extend its body.
This is COLORIZATION ONLY. Do not redraw, age up, change clothing coverage, reshape facial features, smooth away line details, add objects, crop differently, create a shield frame, add webpage UI, headings, new lettering, or a new watermark. Keep the background opaque.
